The Fire-Feathered Serpent sleeps beneath the sea of Oramond. When the players on the server kill 2000 {creature:Seacrest Serpent|Seacrest Serpents}, it wakes up and the normal quaras and serpents of the {wiki:Seacrest Grounds|Seacrest Grounds} are replaced by {wiki:Quara#Quara_Renegades|Renegade Quaras}. While it lasts, the mission The Fire-Feathered Sea Serpent of the {wiki:Twenty Miles Beneath the Sea Quest|Twenty Miles Beneath the Sea Quest} becomes available, which gives access to the achievements **Mind the Step!** and **Snake Charmer**.
In the depths of the sea sleeps a Fire-Feathered Serpent, but its Guardian needs help to protect its realm.
Guide Kunibert, Rathleton (ask about the serpent's status)
Equipment for hunting underwater in the Seacrest Grounds
or another diving helmet; without it you take drown damage underwater
Chance to do the *The Fire-Feathered Sea Serpent* mission of the {wiki:Twenty Miles Beneath the Sea Quest|Twenty Miles Beneath the Sea Quest}
Chance to earn the achievements **Mind the Step!** and **Snake Charmer**
Mission *The Fire-Feathered Sea Serpent* of the {wiki:Twenty Miles Beneath the Sea Quest}
Only available while this world change is active.
This is the mission where you earn the achievements **Mind the Step!** and **Snake Charmer**.
Unlike most {wiki:World Changes|world changes}, this one changes state **immediately** when it is triggered, and not at the next {wiki:Server Save|server save}.
Ask any guide NPC about {key:sea serpent} to find out what state the serpent is in.

Normally the serpent is asleep and in the {wiki:Seacrest Grounds|Seacrest Grounds} you find normal {wiki:Quaras|quaras}, {creature:Sea Serpent|Sea Serpents} and {creature:Seacrest Serpent|Seacrest Serpents}. Ask a guide NPC (for example {npc:Guide Kunibert}, in Rathleton) about {key:sea serpent}.

Go to **Rathleton** (Oramond): by boat, say {key:hi}, {key:oramond} and {key:yes} to your city's captain. Leave Rathleton by the **west** side and head **northwest** to {npc:Mr Brandon} ({coord:33550,31869,7}). Enter the {item:Magic Forcefield} to the **south** of him, swim to the **north** side of the water and enter the {item:Maelstrom}: you appear in the Seacrest Grounds, near the {npc:Guardian of the Deep Seas}. The Lost Mountains (west teleport), Sunken City (east teleport) and Birthing Grounds (north teleport) areas only open with missions 1, 2 and 3 of the {wiki:Twenty Miles Beneath the Sea Quest|Twenty Miles Beneath the Sea Quest}.
Mr Brandon (entrance to the Seacrest Grounds)

On the way to Mr Brandon there are {creature:Devourer|Devourers}, {creature:Blood Beast|Blood Beasts} and {creature:Rot Elemental|Rot Elementals}. Underwater you take drown damage if you do not wear a {item:Helmet of the Deep}.
To wake the serpent, players across the whole server have to kill {creature:Seacrest Serpent|Seacrest Serpents} in the Seacrest Grounds. Each one you kill counts towards the world total.

To return to the surface from the spot where you arrived through the Maelstrom, go up the ramp to the **east** and enter the **south** {item:Magic Forcefield}: it takes you back to {npc:Mr Brandon}. If you are in one of the other areas, enter the teleport back so that you appear next to the four teleports and use the **south** one. Then walk southeast back to Rathleton.
Mr Brandon (exit from the Seacrest Grounds)
2. The serpent starts to wake up (1000 kills)

When the server reaches **1000** Seacrest Serpents killed, the world change is not yet triggered, but a message appears to the whole server: *"Sleeping beneath the Oramond sea, the Fire-Feathered Serpent twitches and dreams of calling its children back."* If the quara invasion of western Oramond is under way, it stops immediately and all the quaras disappear from the surface.

With another **1000** kills (2000 in total), the world change is triggered. The normal quaras, Sea Serpents and Seacrest Serpents are replaced by {wiki:Quara#Quara_Renegades|Renegade Quaras}. All players receive the message *"The Fire-Feathered Serpent has awoken! Renegade Quara attack the sunken lands of Oramond!"*

Now the mission *The Fire-Feathered Sea Serpent* of the {wiki:Twenty Miles Beneath the Sea Quest|Twenty Miles Beneath the Sea Quest} becomes available. If you want to do it, or if you want to hunt the Renegade Quaras, go **quickly** to the Seacrest Grounds (through {npc:Mr Brandon}, as in the step *Getting to the Seacrest Grounds*).
This state usually lasts only a short time.
4. The serpent goes back to sleep

After the mission is done and **2000** Renegade Quaras are killed, the serpent goes back to sleep and everything returns to normal. The message *"The Fire-Feathered Serpent goes back to sleep, beseeched by the blood of the Renegade Quara."* appears.
